subject: [AMBER] The conversion between V and kcal/(mol*A*e) in external electric field.

messages.author: $B3T(B $B2HHM(B
messages.body:
Dear Users,
I want to apply an external electric field during MD simulations. I'm confused by the units kcal/(mol*A*e) and parameter settings in external electric field.
What is the kcal/(mol*A*e) means? What is the relationship with voltage in reality? The conversion between V and kcal/(mol*A*e)?
How to understand $B!H(Bthe x, y, z (efx, efy, efz) components are scaled to box size$B!I(B when efn=1?
How to use $B!H(Befphase$B!I(B and $B!H(Beffreq$B!I(B to set external electric field over time?
I will appreciate if someone could provide me some advices or references.
Best regards
Jiafan, Guo
